title: How to Jump-Start a Dead Car Safely (Part 1)
hook: Stop! Wrong jumper cables can fry your car.

script.narration: Stop! Wrong jumper cables can fry your car.
script.visual_search: sparks flying from car battery jumper cables

script.narration: Here is how to jump-start safely in three steps. First, turn both cars off and clamp red to the dead positive, then the good positive.
script.visual_search: connecting red jumper cable to car battery

script.narration: Second, clamp black to the good negative, then to unpainted metal on the dead car—never its battery. Third, start the good car, wait two minutes, then start yours.
script.visual_search: mechanic starting car engine hood open

description:
Learn how to jump-start a dead car battery safely in 3 easy steps without damaging your vehicle's electronics or causing dangerous sparks.

Knowing the exact jumper cable order is an essential driving tip for every car owner. Always double-check your positive and negative terminals before connecting.

Follow Learn in 60 Seconds for Part 2 and more quick auto maintenance tips!
